newsitem.title: USA: USDA buys 2.14 mln lbs frozen pork for programs.
newsitem.headline: USDA buys 2.14 mln lbs frozen pork for programs.

text.p: The Agricultural Marketing Service of the U.S. Department of Agriculture said it bought 2,138,400 lbs of frozen pork products for distribution in the National School Lunch Program and other federal programs.
Total purchases of frozen pork since the program was announced on August 19 follow:
Awards made today for Announcement LS-50, Invitation 13, to be shipped between November 27 and December 10, 1996.
Winning bidder for the rib-shaped patties was Don Lee Farms (Inglewood CA) 118,800 lbs.
Winning biiders for the 3-ounce pork sausage patties was Cherry Meat Packers Inc (Chicago IL) 554,400 lbs.
Winning bidders for the fine frozen ground pork were IBP Inc (Storm Lake IA and Columbus Junction IA) 1,069,200 lbs, and Swift and Co (Louisville KY) 396,000 lbs.
